description: E5 SPECT split-sensitivity arm (LOG.md R6): identical to configs/e5_fig7_spect_classical.json except that SPECT.train and SPECT.test are pooled (267 rows) and a quarter (66 rows, split_seed 0) is held out for testing (N_train = 201). The paper's text names the standard SPECT test set (p13), but its h = 1 point (Fig. 7e,f) and its Fig. 8 threshold (N_train = 200) match this pooled split. Not the as-stated paper protocol.
